title: 第 十七章 租住洞府第十八 章 授业
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆行雨不再继续调侃陆行舟，转而神色认真地告诉他。
这是族长的意思，让她跟着陆行舟学习炼丹之术。
顺便看看能否在这流云仙城谋得发展之机。
陆行雨此前曾管理过青云坊市的商铺，不仅具备管理能力。
而且她的灵根适合学习炼丹，综合考量之下，她无疑是最佳人选。
“三弟，你务必按照最严格的标准来教我，家族资源有限，可容不得半点浪费。”陆行雨一脸郑重的说道。
族长深知学习炼丹所需资源消耗巨大，故而狠下心来，让陆行雨带走了家族大半的资源。
这一举动使得陆家其他修士的生活变得愈发艰难，他们每月领取的资源直接锐减一半。
但即便如此，族中上下依旧对陆行雨也是寄予了厚望。
“大姐，你可得做好心理准备，到时候可别嫌累。”陆行舟笑着打趣道。
“放心吧，绝对不会！”
陆行雨信心满满地回应。
陆行舟见她如此坚定，二话不说，伸手从储物袋中取出之前从六姑那儿得到的《灵药大全》玉简，径直丢给陆行雨。
“大姐，给你三个月时间，务必将这玉简里记载的所有灵药及其属性，都牢牢地记清楚，三个月后考核。”
“行，没问题！”
陆行雨毫不犹豫的应下，接过玉简，便转身匆匆返回自己的房间。
这三个月里，陆行雨都未曾踏出房间半步，每日都在背诵玉简中的灵药知识。
她不想辜负大家对她的信任。
三个月后，经过考核，陆行舟将那份一阶炼丹师心得交到陆行雨手中。
“大姐，你先好好琢磨琢磨这份心得，等你觉得有把握了，再来找我。”

拿到炼丹心得，陆行雨很是兴奋，她头也不回的跑回房间就研究了起来。
而陆行舟自己，则一边炼丹，一边打磨着体内积累的丹毒。
经过一段时间的研究，陆行雨自觉已将心得吃透了，便满心欢喜的找到陆行舟。
“三弟，咱们可以开始啦！”陆行雨兴奋的说道，眼中闪烁着光芒。
看着她这副跃跃欲试的模样，陆行舟不禁想起了当初初涉炼丹时的自己，嘴角微微上扬，忍不住笑了出来。
“大姐，咱们得换个地方居住，这儿可不适合你炼丹。”
毕竟新手炼丹，容易炸炉，一旦发生，很容易惊扰到客栈里的其他客人。
陆行舟心中早有打算，他盘算着在流云仙城租一个修炼洞府，毕竟自己很可能要在这儿长期待下去。
随后，两人迅速收拾好行囊，离开客栈，朝着仙城管事处走去。
管事处的大堂内，一位身着墨色锦袍的中年修士，见有人进来，赶忙满脸热情的迎了上去。
“请问二位道友，有什么需要在下帮忙的吗？”
“我们想租一间带有炼丹室的修炼洞府，不知是否还有空余？”陆行舟开口问道。
“二位稍等片刻，我这就帮你们查看一下。”
中年修士言罢，从储物袋中取出一块玉牌，往里面注入法力。
瞬间，玉牌光芒大放，变得硕大无比。
只见玉牌之上，密密麻麻地分布着各种颜色的小点。
“二位道友，符合你们要求的洞府还有，不过位置较为偏远，靠近仙城边缘。”
中年修士一边说着，一边指了指玉牌边缘的几处位置。
陆行舟对于洞府的位置倒没有太多要求，只要能满足修炼需求即可。
content_en:
Lu Xingyu stopped teasing Lu Xingzhou and turned to tell him seriously.
This was the intention of the clan leader, asking her to learn the art of alchemy from Lu Xingzhou.
By the way, let's see if we can find development opportunities in Liuyunxian City.
Lu Xingyu had managed shops in Qingyunfang City before, and he not only had management capabilities.
Moreover, her spiritual roots are suitable for learning alchemy. After all considerations, she is undoubtedly the best candidate.
"Third brother, you must teach me according to the strictest standards. The family resources are limited and there is no room for any waste." Lu Xingyu said solemnly.
The clan leader knew that learning alchemy required a huge amount of resources, so he was ruthless and let Lu Xingyu take away most of the family's resources.
This move made the lives of other monks in the Lu family more and more difficult, and the resources they received each month were directly cut in half.
But even so, everyone in the clan still had high hopes for Lu Xingyu.
"Sister, you have to be mentally prepared and don't feel tired when the time comes." Lu Xingzhou joked with a smile.
"Don't worry, it won't happen!"
Lu Xingyu responded confidently.
Lu Xingzhou saw that she was so determined. Without saying a word, he reached out from his storage bag and took out the jade slip of the "Encyclopedia of Spiritual Medicine" he had received from Liu Gu before, and threw it directly to Lu Xingyu.
"Sister, I will give you three months to memorize all the elixirs and their properties recorded in this jade slip. You will be assessed in three months."
"Okay, no problem!"
Lu Xingyu agreed without hesitation, took the jade slip, turned around and hurried back to his room.
In the past three months, Lu Xingyu had not even stepped out of his room. He had been reciting the elixir knowledge contained in the jade slips every day.
She didn't want to betray everyone's trust in her.
Three months later, after the assessment, Lu Xingzhou handed over the experience of being a first-level alchemist to Lu Xingyu.
"Sister, please think carefully about this experience first, and then come to me when you feel confident."
Lu Xingyu was very excited after getting the alchemy experience. She ran back to the room and started studying it without looking back.
Lu Xingzhou himself was refining elixirs while polishing the accumulated erysipelas in his body.
After a period of research, Lu Xingyu felt that he had understood everything, and he happily found Lu Xingzhou.
"Third brother, we can start!" Lu Xingyu said excitedly, his eyes twinkling.
Seeing her eagerness to try, Lu Xingzhou couldn't help but think of himself when he first got involved in alchemy. The corners of his mouth raised slightly and he couldn't help but laugh.
"Sister, we have to find another place to live. This place is not suitable for you to make alchemy."
After all, novices in alchemy can easily explode the furnace. Once this happens, it will easily disturb other guests in the inn.
Lu Xingzhou had already made plans in his mind. He was planning to rent a training cave in Liuyun Immortal City. After all, he was likely to stay here for a long time.
Afterwards, the two quickly packed their bags, left the inn, and walked towards the Immortal City Management Office.
In the lobby of the steward's office, a middle-aged monk wearing a dark brocade robe saw someone coming in and hurriedly greeted him with enthusiasm.
"Excuse me, fellow Taoists, do you need any help?"
"We want to rent a training cave with an alchemy room. Is there any room available?" Lu Xingzhou asked.
"You two, wait a moment. I'll check it out for you right now."
After the middle-aged monk finished speaking, he took out a jade tablet from his storage bag and injected magic power into it.
In an instant, the jade plaque shone brightly and became extremely huge.
I saw small dots of various colors densely distributed on the jade tablet.
"Two fellow Taoists, there is still a cave that meets your requirements, but the location is relatively remote, close to the edge of the fairy city."
As the middle-aged monk spoke, he pointed to several locations on the edge of the jade plaque.
Lu Xingzhou didn't have many requirements for the location of the cave, as long as it could meet his training needs.
